name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: A marketplace of focused agent skills that audit any website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement problems, then emit a single structured report of evidence-backed findings and prioritized fixes.

skills.concern: Compose sub-audits and emit the final report
Can the crawler get in? (robots, sitemap, status, canonical, AI bots)
Can a machine read the page? (static-vs-rendered fact gap)
Can it pick out the fact? (JSON-LD / schema, metadata, entity clarity)
Is it trusted? (stale facts, single-source claims, identity collision)
Is it easy to quote? (self-contained, extractable claims / FAQ)
Do arriving visitors stay? (orientation, CTA, speed, mobile)
